honest_steps_progress : ∀ (admins : List ℕ) (G : ℕ) (s : St) (w lid b : ℕ) (as : List ℕ),
  s.halted = false →
    leaseOf s w = some lid →
      budgetOf s lid = some b →
        lid ∉ s.revoked →
          spentL s lid + charges as ≤ b →
            spentT s + charges as ≤ G →
              (run admins G full s (List.map (fun a => Op.work w a a) as)).usage =
                s.usage ++ List.map (fun a => (w, lid, a)) as
